output.summary: The group's roughly 17.6 minute ticket time stems from the October 2024 Made Here redesign. The board knowingly accepted the longer time, projecting about 18 minutes with a 19 minute ceiling. Check, same-store sales and satisfaction all rose, and the Pellston 12-minute benchmark panel excludes scratch kitchens. Only Riverside deviated, from August 2026. KDS timings, the unfilled saute/pasta vacancy and the deferred transfer requests show a local staffing gap that is being left unfilled. Group-wide inefficiency, a staffing spread and satisfaction erosion are contradicted. Freezing components (the 2024 trial cut food quality) and a ticket-time bonus (the 2023 audit found gaming) are harmful. Firing the GM is unjustified. Delgado's reason for leaving stays unresolved.
